1.

Holy, holy, holy, Lord God Almighty! When the new day dawns, our song of praise to Thee ascends. Holy, holy, holy, gracious and mighty, Thee we worship, God and Father ours.

2.

Holy, holy, holy, sing all saints, Cast down their golden crowns before Thy glory. Before Thee cherubim and seraphim fall. Thou wast, and art, and shalt be in eternity.

3.

Holy, holy, holy, high and inaccessible Is Thy brightness clear, which no sinful eye beholds. Eternal is Thy grace, Thy love imperishable. All-good, unto the children of dust Thou lookest down.

4.

Holy, holy, holy, Lord God Almighty! Over heaven, earth, and seas Thy reign extends. Holy, holy, holy, gracious and mighty, Thee we worship, God and Father ours.
